title: 微软新项目团队怎样建立合作关系
topic: Engagement Team Development：识别协作偏好并建立可调整的工作约定

source.title: Engagement Team Development - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook

paragraphs: In every ISE engagement, dynamics are different so are the team requirements. Based on transfer learning among teams, we aim to build right "code-with" environments in every team.

This documentation gives a high-level template with some suggestions by aiming to accelerate team swarming phase to achieve a high speed agility however it has no intention to provide a list of "must-do" items.
Sync/Async communication methods, work hours/flexible times
Identification of communication channels, feedback loops and recurrent team call slots out of regular sprint meetings
Team is also responsible to keep the plan up-to-date based on team changes/needs and debugging results.
translations: 每个 ISE 合作项目的情况不同，团队需求也不同。我们希望借鉴团队间的经验，为每支团队建立合适的 code-with 协作环境。
这份文档提供一个高层次的模板和若干建议，目的是加快团队协同磨合、提升敏捷协作速度；但它并不打算把这些建议列成必须逐项执行的清单。
同步/异步沟通方式，以及工作时间和弹性安排。
识别沟通渠道、反馈闭环，以及常规迭代会议之外定期安排的团队通话时段。
团队也有责任根据团队和需求的变化以及敏捷调试的结果，持续更新计划。
fullTextParagraphs: In every ISE engagement, dynamics are different so are the team requirements. Based on transfer learning among teams, we aim to build right "code-with" environments in every team.

This documentation gives a high-level template with some suggestions by aiming to accelerate team swarming phase to achieve a high speed agility however it has no intention to provide a list of "must-do" items.

As it's stated in Tuckman's team phases, traditional team development has several stages. However those phases can be extremely fast or sometimes mismatched in teams due to external factors, what applies to ISE engagements.

In order to minimize the risk and set the expectations on the right way for all parties, an identification phase is important to understand each other. Some potential steps in this phase may be as following (not limited):
Working agreement
Identification of styles/preferences in communication, sharing, learning, decision making of each team member
Talking about necessity of pair programming
Decisions on backlog management & refinement meetings, weekly design sessions, social time sessions...etc.
Sync/Async communication methods, work hours/flexible times
Decisions and identifications of charts that will be helpful to provide transparent and true information to everyone
Identification of "Software Craftspersonship" areas which means the tools and methods will be widely used during the engagement and taking the required actions on team upskilling side if necessary.
GitHub, Visual Studio Live Share, Azure DevOps, necessary development tools & libraries, and other collaboration tools.
If upskilling on certain topic(s) is needed, identifying the areas and arranging code spikes for increasing the team knowledge on the regarding topic(s).
Identification of communication channels, feedback loops and recurrent team call slots out of regular sprint meetings
Introduction to Technical Agility Team Manifesto and planning the technical delivery by aiming to keep technical debt risk minimum.

Identification phase accelerates the process of building a safe environment for every individual in the team, later on team has the required assets to follow the plan. And it is team's itself responsibility (engineers,PO,Process Lead) to debug their Agility level.

In every team stabilization takes time and pro-active agile debugging is the best accelerator to decrease the distraction away from sprint/engagement goal. Team is also responsible to keep the plan up-to-date based on team changes/needs and debugging results.
Just as an example, agility debugging activities may include:
Dashboards related with "Goal" such as burndown/burnout, Item/PR Aging, Mood Chart ..etc. are accessible to the team and team is always up-to-date
Backlog Refinement meetings
Size of stories (Too big? Too small?)
Are "User Stories" and "Tasks" clear ?
Are Acceptance Criteria enough and right?
Is everyone ready-to-go after taking the User Story/Task?
Running efficient retrospectives
Is the Sprint Goal clear in every iteration ?
Is the estimation process in the team improving over time or does it meet the delivery/workload prediction?
Kindly check Scrum Values to have a better understanding to improve team commitment.
Following that, above suggestions aim to remove agile/team disfunctionalities and provide a broader team understanding, potential time savings and full transparency.
Tuckman's Stages of Group Development
Scrum Values

notes.meaning: 项目中的协作开发环境
notes.explain: 指南用 code-with 描述合作项目里的协作环境，但没有把它定义成结对编程；结对编程只是团队可以讨论的一种做法。
notes.example: We use a code-with approach to work alongside the client team.

notes.explain: 源文借用了机器学习术语 transfer learning，想表达团队之间借鉴经验；这不是一般团队协作中常用的固定搭配。
notes.example: We can share lessons across teams.

notes.phrase: by aiming to accelerate team swarming phase to achieve a high speed agility
notes.meaning: 帮助团队尽快进入有效协作
notes.explain: 这是源文的非标准表达。自然表达可说 help the team start working together effectively sooner；不要把原句当成自然英语范例。
notes.example: These suggestions can help a new team start working together effectively sooner.

notes.explain: 原文明确说这份模板不是强制清单。团队应结合当前成员的偏好和项目需要讨论具体约定。
notes.example: These suggestions are a starting point, not a list of must-do items.

notes.explain: 同步沟通要求双方同时参与；异步沟通允许稍后查看和回复。源文建议讨论适合团队的方式，没有规定哪一种更好。
notes.example: Let’s decide which questions need a call and which updates can stay async.

notes.meaning: 定期安排的团队通话时段
notes.explain: 这里说的是常规迭代会议之外的定期通话安排，源文没有规定每天、每周或具体分钟数。
notes.example: We can add a recurring call slot outside the regular sprint meetings.

notes.phrase: Team is also responsible to keep the plan up-to-date
notes.meaning: 团队也负责持续更新计划
notes.explain: 这是源文原句，语法不自然。更自然的说法是 “The team is also responsible for keeping the plan up to date.”
notes.example: The team is responsible for keeping the plan up to date as its needs change.

notes.meaning: 同样情况也会出现在 ISE 项目中
notes.explain: 源文此处结构不自然；自然说法可用 “the same can happen in ISE engagements”。
notes.example: The same can happen in ISE engagements.

notes.explain: 源文搭配不自然；列举内容时通常说 “may include the following” 或 “may be as follows”。
notes.example: Some possible steps may include the following.

notes.explain: 源文这一处有语法错误。自然表达是 “it is the team’s responsibility”，不要照抄 itself responsibility。
notes.example: It is the team’s responsibility to keep the plan up to date.

scenario.title: 新项目团队怎样约定沟通方式（模拟）
english: Jamie is helping a fictional project team agree on how to work together. Priya prefers to talk through complex questions, while Daniel wants routine updates in a channel so he can protect focus time.
The team already has regular sprint meetings, but it has not agreed on where to post updates or when to schedule extra calls. Neither person wants another team’s routine imposed without discussion.

Jamie says, "Could we first discuss what works for this team? Then we can agree on a channel for updates and a recurring call slot for topics that need discussion. We can revisit the plan as our needs change."
chinese: 杰米正在协助一个虚构项目团队商定协作方式。普丽娅更愿意实时讨论复杂问题；丹尼尔希望把日常更新发到沟通频道，以便留出专注时间。
团队已经有常规迭代会议，但还没有商定在哪里发布更新，或何时安排额外通话。两人都不希望未经讨论就照搬另一支团队的流程。
杰米说：“我们能否先谈谈这支团队适合怎样协作？然后商定一个发布更新的频道，并为需要讨论的问题安排定期通话。团队需求变化时，我们可以再调整计划。”

firstAttempt.prompt: 新团队有人偏好实时讨论，有人需要专注时间。请用英文说明不应照搬别的团队的固定流程，并建议先讨论本团队的沟通需要、约定更新渠道和定期讨论时段，之后随需求调整。
firstAttempt.sample: Each team has different needs, so we shouldn’t copy another team’s routine as a fixed checklist. Could we discuss what this team needs before setting a routine? Let’s agree on a channel for updates and a recurring call slot for topics that need discussion. We can revisit the plan as the team’s needs change.
firstAttempt.rationale: 微软来源把团队沟通方式、工作时间和常规会议时段列为可讨论的协作约定；它明确说明建议不是必须照做的清单。这里的具体频道和通话安排是虚构练习中的一种方案。

words.example: Let’s write down our working agreement for project updates.
words.translation: 我们把项目更新的团队约定写下来吧。
words.note: 团队共同商定的协作方式，不是单方面强加的规定。

words.example: We use one communication channel for routine project updates.
words.translation: 我们用一个沟通渠道发布常规项目更新。
words.note: 可以是团队共同使用的聊天频道或项目工具。

words.example: A short call can help with a question that needs synchronous discussion.
words.translation: 需要实时讨论的问题可以通过简短通话处理。
words.note: 交流双方在同一时间互动，例如通话或会议。

words.meaning: 异步的；不要求同时进行的
words.example: We share routine updates through asynchronous communication.
words.translation: 我们通过异步沟通分享常规更新。
words.note: 接收者可以稍后查看和回复，例如频道留言。

words.example: Let’s choose a recurring call slot outside the regular sprint meetings.
words.translation: 我们在常规迭代会议之外，选一个定期通话时段。
words.note: 源文建议团队考虑定期通话时段；没有规定固定频率。

words.example: We can revisit the plan after the team has tried it.
words.translation: 团队试行后，我们可以重新检查这份计划。
words.note: 表示回头检查已约定的做法是否仍适合。

structure.original: In every ISE engagement, dynamics are different so are the team requirements.
analysis: 原文用 so 连接两个完整分句，却没有合适的标点或连词；不要照搬这处不自然表达。
原意是“每个项目的团队情况不同，需求也不同”。自然说法：Each engagement has different dynamics, so team requirements vary.
so 引出结果；在本课可以用 Each team has different needs, so… 说明为什么要先商定适合本团队的做法。
structure.transfer: The team’s time zones differ, so let’s agree on when to use chat and when a call is needed.

rewrite.bad: The last team had a daily call, so we should copy the same schedule.
rewrite.good: Our last team had a daily call, but this team has different needs. Could we agree on a channel for updates and a recurring call outside our regular sprint meetings for topics that need discussion? We can revisit the plan as the team’s needs change.
rewrite.translation: 上一支团队每天通话，但这支团队的需要不同。我们能否商定一个发布更新的频道，并在常规迭代会议之外，为需要讨论的问题安排定期通话？团队需求变化时，我们可以重新检查计划。
rewrite.pattern: Since [each team has different needs], could we agree on [a channel and a recurring call slot] and revisit the plan as [needs change]?

cloze.prompt: Complete the exact phrase from the opening sample: another team’s routine as a fixed ___.
cloze.why: 开头示范使用 fixed checklist，表达这份建议不是强制照搬的固定清单。

cloze.prompt: The lesson word card for “定期重复的” is ___.
cloze.why: recurring 表示定期重复；源文用 recurrent 描述通话时段。

cloze.prompt: Use the exact verb from the task phrase card: We can ___ the plan as the team’s needs change.
cloze.why: revisit 表示回头重新检查已经约定的计划。

dictation.label: 听写 1：先问清团队需要
dictation.text: Could we discuss what this team needs before setting a routine?

apply.prompt: 另一支团队要求大家照搬它的固定日程。请先说明本团队需求可能不同，再提出讨论。
apply.sample: Each team has different needs. Could we discuss what works for this team before setting a routine?

dictation.label: 听写 2：约定渠道并保留调整空间
dictation.text: Let’s agree on a channel for updates and a recurring call slot for topics that need discussion.

apply.prompt: 团队试行一个月后，沟通需要发生变化。请提出重新检查约定。
apply.sample: We can revisit the plan as the team’s needs change.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否在定流程前，先谈谈这支团队的实际需要？
translationPractice.answer: Could we discuss what this team needs before setting a routine?
translationPractice.why: 先了解当前团队需要，再决定约定。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们来商定一个发布更新的频道，并为需要讨论的问题安排定期通话。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s agree on a channel for updates and a recurring call slot for topics that need discussion.
translationPractice.why: 频道和定期通话是虚构练习提出的一种团队约定，不是微软规定的固定方案。

translationPractice.prompt: 团队需求变化时，我们可以重新检查计划。
translationPractice.answer: We can revisit the plan as the team’s needs change.
translationPractice.why: 变化后重新检查，不代表任何一套约定永远适用。

choice.prompt: 另一支团队要求新项目组每天都开 15 分钟同步会。哪种回复最符合微软指南的意思？
options: Every team should follow that schedule because it worked before.
Each team has different needs. Could we discuss which updates can be async and when a recurring call would help, then adjust the plan as we learn?
No one should ever use meetings; all communication must be async.
choice.why: 微软将沟通方式和定期通话时段列为团队可讨论的协作约定，并说明建议不是必须照做的清单。指南没有规定每天开会，也没有要求完全异步。

output.prompt: 一个跨时区团队发现，当前额外通话时段总让一位成员无法参加。请用英文建议团队重新讨论更新渠道和定期讨论时间，并说明可以在试行后调整。
output.sample: Our time zones are different, so the current call slot may not work for everyone. Could we discuss which updates can go in the project channel and choose a recurring call time that includes the team? Let’s try it and revisit the plan after the next sprint.
check: 是否说明现有安排可能不适合所有成员？
是否提出讨论异步更新渠道？
是否重新商定能让团队参与的定期通话时段？
是否说明试行后再检查计划？
